reviews.title: Fast Shipping, Fast Card, Behaves Well
reviews.comment: Was slightly concerned buying this given the GPU market right now.  The card was shipped promptly and was received just as promptly. It was harder to get the old card out than out this one in.  I will be looking at an extra support.  The heatsink is simply massive.  Drivers installed easily.  FFXIV runs approximately twice as fast for me with this as opposed to a GTX 1080.  Need to play with the Vibrance and Overclocking.  Input lag seems better and switching in and out of FFXIV now takes less than 1 second instead of 5 to 7 though I would not know if that issue with the 1080 was due to the card, driver or some setting I flipped at some point.  Turned the FPS down to 60 for now due to avoiding DSC which at 4K can make some text harder to see on any card.  Depends on ones eyes somewhat.  I just need to look for an HDMI 2.1 monitor now. This card is fast and behaves nicely.
reviews.author: Steven H.  Rhoades

reviews.title: Ultimate card for the price!
reviews.comment: Got this card around the $655 range as it was slashed from the $950 range. I may be spoiled because I’m used to cheaper GPU prices, even though they have dropped back to almost normal. Maybe if it was $100-$200 less, I’d say this would be a true bargain. This with my LG FreeSync Premium monitor on 144hz, 4K, and UHD. Handles all games like a champ and beasts it out on max settings for games. GPU temp seems relatively stable as well. Amazing card and I would highly suggest buying if you can shell out the money.
reviews.author: Robert Ouch

reviews.title: 6800XT TUF is a solid card!
reviews.comment: As a first time PC builder. I was very impressed with graphics card and the fps rate was able to dish out. The price was the only issue. Due to the pandemic and the short supply of the graphics card. But was lucky to get from Asus itself. But if you are willing to wait. Good luck with that.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Eh. It’s okay for a beginner GPU.
reviews.comment: Officially have had this for over a year. GPU is very heavy and I needed a support bracket to keep it from bending, which kinda sucks since I used it for my first PC build; having to worry about expensive gear breaking after spending so much money is not worth it. It is good, though not the best gpu out there. If you’re a once in a while gamer like me, where I play Minecraft or Palworld for like a month and then stop playing for who knows how long until I pick it back up again, then it’s for you. If you’re a heavy gamer, save your money for a better one. Other than that, this GPU is solid and works just fine. You can get 4K and 60fps, but there are others that can do much better. This thing kinda strugges with 120fps on Minecraft.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer
